subject: Post-call: model fit + follow-up on quality regression and rollback options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patterson <sam@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@acme-inc.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: model fit + follow-up on next steps

Hi Sam / Olivia,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and clear product fit for Acme's search-snippets and automated product copy use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: you want a model that preserves brand voice, keeps factual SKU attributes intact (no hallucinations), and meets 200ms p95 latency in US-West.
- Recommended starting models: redwood-7B-q4f (fast, cost-effective) for real-time snippets; redwood-14B-ptx (higher quality) for batch content generation.
- I've uploaded our benchmark and the prompt set we discussed: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleBenchmark — the file "acme-promptset-v1.jsonl" contains the 120 sample prompts you shared during the call.
- Next steps:
  1) We’ll run a quick eval against the redwood-7B-q4f and redwood-14B-ptx with your prompt set (ETA: 48 hrs).
  2) We'll send a short eval report and failing examples if we see regressions.
  3) If quality delta exceeds your threshold, options are: pin to previous model version, rollback the platform update for your tenant, or tune prompts.

I attached a short eval template and will circulate the initial report once the jobs complete. Is a 2pm PT sync next Wednesday good to review?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachment: acme-eval-report-20260710.pdf (summary + eval template)

From: Sam Patterson <sam@acme-inc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit + follow-up on next steps

Marissa — thanks for the recap and moving quickly on the eval. A heads-up: our engineering team just flipped to the newest redwood-7B-q4f@v2.1 in production for the snippets flow yesterday (scheduled maintenance). Since then we've started seeing a bump in incorrect SKU mappings and some brand-voice drift in shorter snippets. I pulled a few examples and put them in the attached failing-prompts-samples.txt.

Can you confirm whether the evaluation you're running will reflect v2.1? If v2.1 is the default in the hosted environment, we may need an immediate mitigation plan (pin or rollback) while we complete the prompt adjustments.

Sam
Senior Product Manager, Acme Inc.
sam@acme-inc.com

Attachment: failing-prompts-samples.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patterson <sam@acme-inc.com>
Cc: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@acme-inc.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit + follow-up on next steps

Sam — sorry to hear that and thanks for sending the examples. Looping in Dev (dev_patel) and Rachel from platform so we can triage.

Primary asks:
- Dev / platform: can you confirm which model version Acme's tenant is currently pinned to in Hosted?
- Also can you surface a quick diff between v2.0 and v2.1 for redwood-7B-q4f (any tokenization/quantization changes or fine-tune deltas)?

Sam — we'll aim to get a mitigation plan by EOD PST. If it's straightforward we can pin back to v2.0 for your tenant and schedule a controlled rollout after we understand the regression.

Best,
Marissa

From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sam Patterson <sam@acme-inc.com>
Cc: rachel_kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit + follow-up on next steps

Hi team — quick technical update after looking at the logs and the samples Sam provided.

1) Versioning: Acme's tenant was auto-upgraded to redwood-7B-q4f@v2.1 on 2026-07-12 02:11:00 UTC during the regional rollout. We can pin the tenant to redwood-7B-q4f@v2.0 within the hosting control plane immediately (no infra change).

2) Diff summary (v2.0 -> v2.1):
   - quantization tweak: switch from q4f static scale to q4f adaptive scale (improves avg perplexity on open benchmarks but changed low-context behavior for some short prompts).
   - tokenization normalization: slight update to unicode normalization which can alter whitespace-sensitive SKU tokens.
   - no additional fine-tune on brand data was applied for Acme-specific models.

3) Mitigation options:
   a) Pin Acme tenant to v2.0 (fast, reversible).
   b) Rollback v2.1 globally for the region (requires change window, impacts other tenants).
   c) Apply prompt-level normalization (transform pipeline) to preserve SKU tokens; we can prototype in 24-48 hrs.

Requested from Acme: if you can share ~10 high-priority failing prompts (you already sent a handful), we'll run a side-by-side eval against v2.0 and v2.1 and include token-level diffs. I've started that job and will post results as soon as it's finished.

Operational note: pinning per-tenant preserves our ability to continue the regional rollout while isolating the regression. If you want us to pin now, confirm and we'll execute and notify you once complete.

— Dev
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
dev_patel@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patterson <sam@acme-inc.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: model fit + follow-up on next steps — plan and next steps

Sam / Olivia — quick summary and proposed plan so everyone has a single source of truth: 

1) We've reviewed your failing examples and Dev has kicked off a side-by-side eval (v2.0 vs v2.1) focusing on SKU tokenization and short-snippet QA. Results will be shared by EOD today.

2) Immediate mitigation: if you'd like, we can pin your tenant to redwood-7B-q4f@v2.0 right away. This is reversible and will isolate your traffic from the regional rollout. Please reply with "PIN" to authorize the change, and we'll schedule the pin for a 10-minute execution window (we'll notify you when complete).

3) Longer-term: after we complete the diff report, options are: keep v2.0 until we issue a follow-up patch to normalize tokenization, or accept v2.1 and apply a prompt-normalization transform on Acme's ingest path. We'll include cost/latency implications in the report.

4) Checkpoint: proposed 2pm PT sync on Wed July 22 to review final eval and next steps unless you'd prefer an earlier call.

Thanks — let me know if you want us to pin now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
